sources.note: Inspected 2026-10-02: owner screenshot highlighting missing foliage. Image/capture date unknown. Registered to mapped Burns and Adriatico roof corners and checked against Alingal, Phelan, Xavier and covered-court footprints. Crowns/positions are schematic estimates within traced visible foliage, not surveyed trunks or an exact tree count. Heights use the generic 10 m default; species unspecified. Entrance planting is modeled as low shrubs. Vegetation is undated; no timeline dates inferred.
